arms.A1_PER_VARIABLE: every population variable replaced by its selected operator; dimension equals A0
arms.A2_AUGMENTED: per variable: untransformed, selected operator, and their difference where both are defined

A3_CAPACITY_CONTROL.controls: the extra dimension of A2 only; it is not a comparator for A1
A3_CAPACITY_CONTROL.generation: i.i.d. Normal(mu_train, sigma_train) where mu_train and sigma_train are the mean and sample standard deviation of the corresponding source variable on the TRAINING fold only
A3_CAPACITY_CONTROL.inputs: A0 inputs plus, per variable, exactly as many extra columns as A2 adds for it

common_sample.frozen: its digest is recorded before any model is fitted and every arm is evaluated on exactly it
common_sample.rule: the intersection, across all four arms, of samples that are eligible after the maximum warm-up (512 bars) and the temporal mask

H1.question: does replacing each variable by its selected causal operator beat identity at the SAME dimension?

H2.question: does the augmented representation beat both identity and the same number of columns carrying no target information?

H3.question: abstention frequency, selection stability across origins, and no harm under a change of panel

algorithm: sort the family's one-sided p-values ascending
for rank i of m, adjusted_p = max over ranks <= i of min(1, (m - i + 1) * p_i)
report the rank-i lower bound at level 1 - alpha/(m - i + 1)

inference.sensitivity: leave-one-panel-out: every contrast recomputed without each panel; a claim requires every LOPO lower bound to clear its margin
inference.test: one-sided paired t on panel values against the margin
inference.unit: one value per panel per contrast: the mean over origins and seeds of (MAE(comparator) - MAE(arm)) / MAE(comparator) on the frozen common sample

panels.below_minimum: BANK_INSUFFICIENT; the screen does not run
panels.independence: distinct dataset and distinct underlying instrument or source
panels.inventory: built from artifacts without reading any score

artifacts.temporal: ETH_H4_TEMPORAL_CONTRACT.v2 and its sample eligibility mask, one per panel

population.empty: reported as empty; no requirement is relaxed
excluded_by_rule: variables available only after the origin
requires_all: FEATURE_DAG.v4 class CAUSAL_ACTIVE with a complete binding
declared unit, where the semantic type has one (not UNKNOWN)

rules.abstention: a variable with no operator beating identity by 0.1% on inner validation keeps O0 and counts as an abstention in H3
rules.harm: a panel with A1 minus A0 below -0.02 is harmed; any harm blocks H1
rules.incompleteness: an arm over budget or failing makes its panel NOT_EVALUABLE for every arm
rules.missingness: rows with non-finite inputs are dropped identically for every arm before the common sample is frozen
rules.null_result: NO_EVIDENCE_OF_BENEFIT, reported, never re-run with other settings

supersedes.why: A3 sat in H1 although A1 adds no dimension; t inference with 3 panels; no semantic, unit, role, license or missing-policy requirement; no temporal-quality exclusion; Holm as prose

temporal_quality.next_bar: the next NOMINAL interval; an absent bar is an absent target, never the next observed row
temporal_quality.rule: a sample is excluded before any fit if its lookback, the operator window or its target contains a truncated bar or crosses a gap, per the panel's temporal quality mask
